information_updates.finding: The radiative-cooling membrane combines PVDF-HFP, boron nitride nanosheets and hydrophobic SiO2 in a lotus-like microstructure to pursue spectral selectivity plus self-cleaning; use as a passive thermal-management/material-architecture reference.

The metallic-glass paper uses temperature-scanning XPCS to distinguish liquid-like from stress-driven dynamics, providing a strong methodology reference for time-resolved structural relaxation and model validation.

The 2026 confidence-scoring paper combines predictions from multiple models with normalized assertion/prompt-based confidence scoring and filters low-confidence data; use as a candidate precedent for PRIME/SARA evidence-quality triage.
information_updates.claims_boundary: 79776 is the article identifier; methodology requires independent evaluation before adoption.

information_updates.finding: The NOAA internal-wave/aerosol study compares lidar observations with a simple interaction model and reports agreement for two of three flights, making it useful as an environmental sensor-model reconciliation case.
